items.msg: modal pad size (0.8, 0.8) mm != datasheet (0.7, 0.7) mm (tol 0.1)

land_pattern.notes: From the KT-0603R datasheet section 2 'Package Profile & Soldering PAD Suggested' (p.2, fetched via the wmsc.lcsc.com mirror): two 0.70 x 0.70 mm pads separated by a 0.70 mm gap (=1.40 mm centre-to-centre). The pulled footprint uses 0.80 x 0.80 pads at 1.50 mm centre-to-centre - the SAME 0.70 mm inter-pad gap with 0.05 mm more pad on every side, so pitch_mm is deliberately omitted (the 1.40 vs 1.50 centre spacing is a consequence of the larger pads, not a mismatch). Datasheet pin (1) is marked '+' = anode, matching the pulled symbol's pin 1 = A.
